latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Black Swan Discovery skill.

- Diagnose hidden unknowns (Black Swans) in negotiations by analyzing deal history, counterpart behavior, and stakeholder context.
- Generates a black-swan-report.md with hypotheses for worldview mismatches, hidden constraints, and hidden agendas.
- Inventories available leverage across three leverage types.
- Produces a prioritized bank of 6-10 investigation questions targeting the highest-priority unknowns.
- Useful for anyone facing stalled negotiations, apparent irrationality, or unclear motivations in high-stakes deals.
